title: Stasis Fuse
description: A young man with purple hair and glowing white fox ears stands with arms outstretched as purple energy tentacles swirl around him. A woman with bright pink hair in a red outfit and cape leaps beside him holding a glowing canister labeled 'STASIS FUSE', both surrounded by magical effects in an enchanted forest.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene in an enchanted dark forest with glowing mushrooms and cherry blossoms. A young man with purple hair and glowing white fox mask ears stands center with arms spread wide wearing a black and blue coat, purple energy tentacles swirling around his body. Beside him a confident woman with flowing bright pink hair wearing a red crop top, shorts, cape and boots leaps forward holding a glowing purple canister labeled STASIS FUSE. Magical sparks, coins, and symbols float in the air under a vibrant pink and purple sky.
